summary: Delegate legacy actor-ci check to distinct installed governance runtime

delivery.outcome: Preserve legacy wellman check --actor ci through the distinct independently installed governance distribution while retaining the full CLI and canonical project execution implementation.
nonGoals: No global executable replacement, PyPI publication, protected runtime pin changes or worker profile activation.
No candidate/adopted-checker fallback, copied governance implementation or execution authority from static conformance.

architecture.decision: Add a bounded compatibility branch to the existing CLI check handler. Explicit actor-ci invocations delegate in an isolated Python child to the separately installed wellmanifest_governance_runtime, verifying its distribution, console entry-point and module ownership. Missing or incompatible installed runtime fails with an actionable prerequisite; preserve stdout/stderr and actual exit status. Existing aggregate checks and project execution retain their implementations.
interfaceChanges: Explicit actor-ci compatibility and exact base/head arguments on wellman check
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded compatibility change; keep previously reviewed runtime artifacts and protected pins unchanged.

validation.evidence: Run real isolated backend fixture processes, reject missing/unrelated/shadowed distributions and preserve arguments/output/exit codes.
Canonical ticket-local environment and scratch; independently qualify exact head before protected Validator publication.
